what_it_is: A clear, free-flowing liquid, which polymerizes quickly on contact with body fluid or tissue; it offers convenient preparation and delivery, customized radiopacity for visualization, and effective penetration of AVMs
sizing_specs: Materials: Trufill n-BCA, Trufill ethiodized oil, and tantalum powder; these components must be used as a system
indications: Embolization of cerebral AVMs when presurgical devascularization is desired; premarket approval device
compatible_with: Prowler EX Microcatheter, CEREBASE DA Guide Sheath, ENTERPRISE 2 Vascular Reconstruction Device; Does not require expensive detachable tip microcatheters or dual lumen balloon catheters
use_notes: Complication rates numerically lower than Onyx LES but not statistically significant. Catheter retention rate 1.6% vs 9.3% for Onyx LES in RCT. Significantly shorter fluoroscopy time (37 vs 57 min, p<0.0001) and procedural time (2.1 vs 2.6 hrs, p=0.001) compared to Onyx LES. Lower total procedural costs than Onyx LES due to not requiring detachable tip microcatheters or dual lumen balloon catheters.
